description:
Don't forget that this is 360 video: you can change the angle of view. 

Uzon is a giant depression, or caldera, which formed about 40,000 years ago after a powerful eruption and the collapse of an ancient volcano. Its dimensions are impressive: about 9 by 12 kilometers. Today, it is a huge basin with steep slopes and a relatively flat bottom at an altitude of about 700 meters above sea level. Nearby is the famous Valley of Geysers, just 20 kilometers away.
